name: Marl Terrier
source:
He is gentle, kind-hearted, and a bit withdrawn at times, but when the time comes, he is able to speak his mind and express his opinions clearly.
A sensible person among the eccentric theater members, he often helps to mediate disputes.
He paints in monochrome with a distinct world view.

[Translated from the [url=https://twitter.com/CFGame_veribaro/status/1552594718244093952]official twitter[/url]]
